parameters.name: Movable
parameters.description: Controls whether the user is allowed to change the GUI window position on the local CPE's display.

parameters.name: Resizable
parameters.description: Controls whether the user is allowed to resize the GUI window on the local CPE's display.

parameters.name: PosX
parameters.description: The horizontal position of the User Interface's top left corner within the local CPE's display measured from the top left corner, expressed in {{units}}.

parameters.name: PosY
parameters.description: The vertical position of the User Interface's top left corner within the local CPE's display measured from the top left corner, expressed in {{units}}.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the user interface within the local CPE's display, expressed in {{units}}.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the user interface within the local CPE's display, expressed in {{units}}.

parameters.name: DisplayWidth
parameters.description: The width of the local CPE's display, expressed in {{units}}.

parameters.name: DisplayHeight
parameters.description: The height of the local CPE's display, expressed in {{units}}.

object.description: This object describes how to remotely manage the initial positioning of a user interface on a device's local display.
